theorem_statement_short: On the canonical hybrid object, direct within-fiber stratumwise thermodynamic separation is not sharp on the audited shell, while packaged conditional weighting yields a stable thermodynamic distinction signal that points toward the conditional disintegration route.

lemmas.label: persistence of distinction under forcing and saturation
